title: CAM Assist Manufacturing Decision Record Schema
description: Portable record capturing why a manufacturing decision was made, prepared and reviewed by humans. A sidecar artifact that travels alongside a strategy package without mutating it. Captures a human declaration; it does not enforce approval authority or authorize machine execution.

record_version.description: Semantic version of the manufacturing decision record format

package_reference.description: Reference to the package this decision concerns. Accepts federated_package_id, relative path, or package directory name.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this decision record was created

prepared_by.description: Informational identifier of who prepared the decision. No trust validation performed.

reviewed_by.description: Informational identifier of who reviewed the decision. No trust validation performed.

assumptions_file.description: Optional reference to a linked manufacturing assumptions sidecar file. Not mutated by this record.

risk_file.description: Optional reference to a linked risk assessment sidecar file. Not mutated by this record.

lineage_file.description: Optional reference to a linked revision lineage sidecar file. Not mutated by this record.

authority.description: Informational authority constraints. When present, every flag MUST be true.

is_informational.description: MUST be true. This record is a human declaration, not an enforcement mechanism.

does_not_authorize_execution.description: MUST be true. This record does not authorize machine execution.

does_not_bypass_human_review.description: MUST be true. This record does not bypass required human review.
